rule_text.name: 701.105a
rule_text.rule: Effects may instruct a creature to seek secrets or seek valor. To do so, its controller creates an Aura Oath attached to that creature.

rule_text.name: 701.105b
rule_text.rule: If a creature "seeks secrets," its controller creates a colorless Aura Oath enchantment token named Oath of Secrets with enchant creature and "Whenever you attack with enchanted creature and at least two other creatures, draw a card, sacrifice this Aura, and fulfill this Oath."

rule_text.name: 701.105c
rule_text.rule: If a creature "seeks valor," its controller creates a colorless Aura Oath enchantment token named Oath of Valor with enchant creature and "Whenever enchanted creature deals combat damage to a player, create a 2/1 white Soldier creature token, sacrifice this Aura, and fulfill this Oath."

rule_text.name: 701.105d
rule_text.rule: Fulfilling an Oath has no rules meaning other than to act as a marker that other abilities can identify.
